name: Katelyn Brook
source: A sixth-year belonging to the House Ruachan. Katelyn made a name for herself by being a constant source of headache for the faculty with her attempts to affect the school's policies. Her wit, enthusiasm and genuine love for Tír na nÓg help her succeed more often than not.
